 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+If pytest is not installed yet:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pip install pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest -v                       # verbose output
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py    # a single test file
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile             # tests matching a name
+```
